headline: Charleston win at Concord and go three points clear
dek: Charleston's win at Concord leaves them on thirty-three points with one match each to play. Concord, three points back, can draw level but cannot pass them, and Davis & Elkins, who beat Frostburg State to sit four back, can no longer catch them.
displaced_by: Charleston beat Concord, so the two are no longer level at the top

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than West Liberty and Wheeling together, and sixteen different players have shared their fifty; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Charleston go into the final round with only Concord able to draw level and no side able to pass them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concord have conceded nine goals in sixteen matches and won eleven of them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan's first win came in their fifteenth match, at Shawnee State, after three draws and eleven defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Martin Echarren has ten goals and three assists for Charleston from thirty-two shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has seven goals and five assists for Frostburg State from thirty-two shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shai'ya Fitzgerald has made sixty-two saves for West Liberty and conceded fifteen goals.

last_match.line: Charleston have now beaten Concord twice, and handed them their first home defeat of the season.

next_match.line: Frostburg State are unbeaten at home; Charleston have won every match away from home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
